rationale: Single series count file with paired technical re-reads per library (columns 1.X/2.X, constant ~3-fold ratio, r=0.995); prepare.R sums each pair into one count per library: cell (in vitro input), IgG (lung metastases, control antibody) and csf1r (lung metastases, anti-Csf1R, Mo-macs depleted). guide=Oligo_Name, gene=Gene_Symbol. The library carries 100 Intergenic and 100 Offtarget control guides (control_gene_pattern ^(Intergenic|Offtarget)), giving 200 controls for calibration. Primary analysis csf1r_vs_IgG reproduces the paper's key MAGeCK comparison (anti-Csf1R vs IgG, paper table mmc5), where the headline hit OPG (Tnfrsf11b) is a top positively selected gene: one library per condition, zero residual df, so rho is pooled across the control guides (no_replicates path) and calls are screening-level. Enrichment is the direction of interest (OPG knockout cells metastasize better when Mo-macs are depleted). A secondary IgG_vs_cell fit gives the metastasis-vs-input axis. Composition is mild (top 1% of guides hold 8-15% of reads), so library totals are kept.
